_comment: What `distctl.py export --to <dir>` may publish from .claude/ and .claude-iff/ into a clean
public copy of this project. Everything else git does not ignore exports as it is.
include: globs relative to the repo root, fnmatch style (`*` also crosses `/`); an entry
ending in `/` names a whole folder, e.g. ".claude/skills/" or ".claude/agents/*.md".
Empty (the default) publishes nothing from .claude/ or .claude-iff/.
This list can only NARROW. A hard-coded floor in distctl.py wins over any entry here: state,
tasks, research, worktrees, private reference, STATUS.md, Project-log.jsonl, LESSONS.jsonl,
the record surface (.claude-iff/obs/), settings.local.json and env files never export.
Kits ship this list empty whatever the source repo chose. Manual: .claude/reference/public-private.md
